messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — scheduling a 1hr dry-run for the incoming penetration test next Tue 09:00 PT. Focus: RBAC change windows, KMS grant flow, audit-log export sanity checks, and vuln triage handoff. Who can join?

mike: I can cover RBAC mappings and the proposed temporary roles.

alex: I’ll take KMS grant/rotation checklist and show the proxy flow.

natalie: I’ll bring the audit-log retention queries and example saved-views.

eng-ops-bot: Reminder: staging cluster snapshot scheduled for 08:00 PT on Tue. Automatic backup + read-only logs exported to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/staging-snapshots/1765432199.zip :package:

sara: Perfect. Agenda draft: 1) Quick run of ephemeral role issuance (15m) 2) KMS proxy grant + decrypt demo (15m) 3) Audit export and evidence packaging (15m) 4) Triage & retest ops (15m).

mike: For ephemeral roles — we should test both assume-role via console and via CI token. Can we add the exact IAM condition snippets in the runbook?

alex: yep. I’ll paste the CLI sequence.

alex: ```bash
# request ephemeral session via sts
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-assume 
  --role-session-name assessor-session --duration-seconds 3600
```

alex: Also will demo KMS grant proxy: we only allow Encrypt/Decrypt for the specific key alias for the readroom S3 path, and revoke after window close.

natalie: Audit export note: please ensure CloudTrail is set to include ReadOnlyEvents=false and DataEvents for S3. Example Athena query for evidence: `SELECT * FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventSource = 's3.amazonaws.com' AND requestParameters->>'bucketName' = 'redwood-pt-evidence';`

mike: One operational question — if a vuln is triaged during the test and needs a hotfix, what’s our rollback corridor? Oncall SLA says 4h for production mitigations, but for the pen-test window we should allow a 1h emergency patch in staging then retest schedule.

sara: Agreed. Proposed process: 1) triage tag in JIRA w/ severity 2) quick patch in staging + smoke test 3) if prod-impacting, schedule emergency change with SRE and get approvals. Documented in the runbook.

eng-ops-bot: Action created: #PT-DRYRUN-1765432199 assigned to @mike, @alex, @natalie — due Tue 08:30 PT. :white_check_mark:

tj: Can we also validate log continuity across KMS key rotation? There was a previous hiccup where logs for decrypt ops vanished for ~30s during key rewrap.

alex: Good call. I’ll run a simulated rotation during the dry-run to verify decrypt telemetry still lands (and show where to find the CloudWatch metric).

natalie: I’ll prepare the evidence manifest template (checksum, S3 path, export-ts, signing key id) so the assessor can verify integrity.

mike: Minor ask — include a short snippet in the runbook with how to redact user identifiers in logs before handing to external assessors.

sara: Noted. Also we should pick retest slots now — propose Wed morning 09:00 PT and Thu 13:00 PT as backups. Which works for everyone?

alex: Wed 09 works for me.

natalie: Wed okay. Thu is fine as fallback.

mike: Wed preferred.

sara: Alright, I’ll lock Wed 09 as primary retest slot. I’ll also publish the pre-PT checklist in the repo (docs/security/pen-tests/prep_checklist.md) and link it in calendar invite.

sara: Quick checklist items I added:
- Confirm ephemeral role ARNs and assume-role test
- KMS grant window documented with revoke procedure
- CloudTrail & S3 DataEvents exported and validated via Athena
- Evidence manifest template in place
- Triage & emergency patch workflow in runbook

tj: If anyone wants to run through a dry scenario voice-call during the run, ping me — I’ll be oncall that day.

mike: I’ll draft the RBAC delta table and push a short PR to infra-runbooks for review tonight.

alex: PR for KMS rotation test coming after I finish the local replay script.

natalie: I’ll attach the Athena saved-views and example query results to the invite.

sara: Thanks team — will send invite + final agenda by EOD. :thumbsup:

eng-ops-bot: Calendar invite sent to participants. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pen-test-dryrun-1765432199
